name: item-in-fire
comment: WP-2.1. Netherrack (87) at (0, 60, 0) in the stone platform and a fire block (51) on it at (0, 61, 0), set with set_block so BlockFire.onBlockAdded schedules its tick (on netherrack it never burns out). Item 0 falls into the fire from (0.5, 64, 0.5): Entity.moveEntity's isBoundingBoxBurning -> EntityItem.dealFireDamage(1) each tick and the fire counter (++fire, 0 -> 300, Entity.java:521-537); Entity.onEntityUpdate's fire % 20 hit (Entity.java:240-252). Item 1 lands on the stone beside it at (2.5, 64, 0.5). entity_state and rng_state every tick.
